title: PM aggregator /program still stalls on a cold first request
body:
## Problem

The PM aggregator's `/program` surface still stalls on a cold first request — the residual boot-window shape left over after #9594 was fixed. Two recurrences since lane 3c closed (PR #9861):

- **Steward run 387 — 2026-11-14 ~09:17 CST:** `/program` returned 503 on pass 1 at 14.88s, then recovered 200 in 0.10s on pass 2. (Noted on #5082: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5082#issuecomment-6879667486)
- **Steward run 393 — 2026-11-14 ~15:17 CST:** `/program` timed out on pass 1 (curl 000 at 25.001s, 0 bytes), then recovered on pass 2 with 200 but slow at 8.43s. (Noted on #5082: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/5082#issuecomment-6884406610)

## Background

Lane 3c (PR #9861, merged 2026-11-14 ~04:16 CST) documented the residual when it closed: in the first ~30–45s after a restart, a cold request can still 503 on empty last-good (the #9594 boot-window shape). Related closed work: #9594 (program cold start boot stall), #9781 (uncached brief comments fan out), PRs #9596 and #9835.

Tracking issue #5082 stays closed — this issue is the dedicated lane for the residual.

## Ask

Root-cause the remaining cold-path stall — the empty last-good window and/or the slow first build — so a cold `/program` request never 503s or times out: the first request after a restart should serve last-good or a fast build, not fail.
